Complete new nonredundant double-coset system, conjugated tensor action and exact-functor filtration proof retained. No first branching theorem4.1 or component/multiplicity variation counted. All selected new representatives, stabilizer computation, tensor action and transported filtrations are fully authored here. Source Proposition3.1 omits a proof for a different first-branching result, which remains uncounted context and is not a premise of the selected second proof. One unselected illustrative semistandard skew-tableau display and its example text at native189--197 are omitted; exact tableau/skew/semistandard definitions remain. Two isolated pointers to that example in185/188 are removed by an inventoried finite prose-only adaptation. The genuine original TikZ mytab macro and every retained proof/tableau diagram are preserved; it is author-written native code, not an emulation of ytableau. No denied package acquisition or mathematical repair.
